title: Pro Shop Store Credit: automatic-reload settings by tier
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Pro Shop Store Credit product line's automatic-reload facet across every tier: whether the tier offers automatic reload at all, the balance level that triggers a reload, the standing reload amount for that tier, whether a payment method on file is required, how many automatic-reload attempts a calendar month allows, and the fee charged per automatic-reload transaction.

## Per-tier basis
| Tier | Automatic reload offered | Balance level that triggers a reload | Standing reload amount | Payment method on file required | Reload attempts allowed per calendar month | Fee per automatic-reload transaction |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Starter Credit $50 Tier | No | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | 0 | 0 USD |
| Standard Credit $100 Tier | No | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | 0 | 0 USD |
| Value Credit $250 Tier | No | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | 0 | 0 USD |
| VIP Credit $500 Tier | No | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | 0 | 0 USD |
| Auto-Reload Standard | Yes | 20.00 USD | 100.00 USD | Yes | 3 | 0 USD |
| Auto-Reload Premium | Yes | 50.00 USD | 250.00 USD | Yes | 3 | 0 USD |

## Points of reference
- Only the Auto-Reload Standard and Auto-Reload Premium tiers currently offer automatic reload; the other four tiers carry no trigger level, standing reload amount, or per-month attempt count, since automatic reload is not offered on them.
- The balance level that triggers a reload is the point the account's spendable balance must drop below before an automatic reload is considered for a tier that offers it.
- The reload attempts allowed per calendar month caps how many automatic reloads may post to the account within one calendar month.

## Basis Q&A
**Does the Auto-Reload Premium tier charge more per automatic reload than the Auto-Reload Standard tier?** No — both currently carry a fee of 0 USD per automatic-reload transaction; the tiers differ instead in their trigger level and standing reload amount.
**Which of the two automatic-reload tiers has the higher trigger level?** Auto-Reload Premium, at 50.00 USD, compared with 20.00 USD for Auto-Reload Standard.
